parameters.query:
SELECT e.id AS notification_domain_event_id
FROM public.notification_domain_events e
JOIN public.notification_jobs j ON j.source_event_id = e.id AND j.clinic_id = e.clinic_id
WHERE e.processing_status IN ('PROCESSED','PENDING')
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.notification_request_job_links l WHERE l.notification_domain_event_id = e.id AND l.notification_job_id = j.id)
  AND e.event_type IN ('no_show.recovery_requested','reminder.requested','review.requested','review.external_request')
ORDER BY e.occurred_at, e.id
LIMIT 100;

WITH planned AS (
  SELECT public.notification_plan_job(
    e.clinic_id,
    a.patient_id,
    a.id,
    conv.id,
    ch.channel_id,
    t.id,
    e.id,
    r.notification_type,
    a.scheduled_at,
    GREATEST(now(), a.scheduled_at + make_interval(mins => r.offset_minutes)),
    a.scheduled_at,
    CASE WHEN a.scheduled_at + make_interval(mins => r.offset_minutes) < now() THEN 'LATE' ELSE NULL END,
    r.priority,
    4,
    'n8n:notifications:v3:' || e.id::text || ':' || r.id::text || ':' || ch.channel_id::text,
    md5(e.id::text || ':' || r.id::text || ':' || ch.channel_id::text || ':' || COALESCE(t.template_fingerprint, ''))
  ) AS job_record
  FROM public.notification_domain_events e
  JOIN public.appointments a ON a.id = e.appointment_id AND a.clinic_id = e.clinic_id AND a.deleted_at IS NULL
  JOIN public.notification_rules r ON r.clinic_id = e.clinic_id AND r.event_type = e.event_type AND r.enabled = true
    AND (e.event_type <> 'reminder.requested' OR (e.event_key LIKE 'communication.requested:%' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.communication_plan_decisions d WHERE d.notification_domain_event_id = e.id AND lower(r.notification_type) = lower(d.notification_type))))
    AND (e.event_type <> 'no_show.recovery_requested' OR ((e.event_key LIKE 'no_show.recovery.initial:%' AND r.notification_type = 'NO_SHOW_RECOVERY_INITIAL') OR (e.event_key LIKE 'no_show.recovery.followup:%' AND r.notification_type = 'NO_SHOW_RECOVERY_FOLLOW_UP') OR (e.event_key LIKE 'no_show.recovery.closed:%' AND r.notification_type = 'NO_SHOW_RECOVERY_CLOSURE') OR (e.event_key LIKE 'no_show.recovery_requested:%' AND r.notification_type = 'NO_SHOW_RECOVERY_REQUEST')))
  JOIN public.notification_templates t ON t.id = r.template_id AND t.clinic_id = r.clinic_id AND t.enabled = true
  JOIN public.notification_dispatch_ready_channels ch ON ch.clinic_id = e.clinic_id AND ch.channel_type = lower(r.channel_type) AND ch.channel_type IN ('whatsapp','messenger','instagram','telegram')
  JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT c.id
    FROM public.conversations c
    WHERE c.clinic_id = e.clinic_id
      AND c.patient_id = a.patient_id
      AND c.channel_id = ch.channel_id
      AND c.deleted_at IS NULL
      AND c.is_archived = false
      AND NULLIF(btrim(c.channel_conversation_id), '') IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY c.last_activity_at DESC NULLS LAST, c.updated_at DESC, c.id DESC
    LIMIT 1
  ) conv ON true
  WHERE e.id = '{{$json.id}}'::uuid
)
SELECT '{{$json.id}}'::uuid AS event_id, count(*)::integer AS planned_jobs FROM planned;
SELECT '{{$json.id}}'::uuid AS job_id, a.attempt_id, a.attempt_number FROM public.notification_begin_attempt('{{$json.id}}'::uuid, 'n8n:notifications:v3:dispatcher') a;

SELECT '{{$json.job_id}}'::uuid AS job_id, '{{$json.attempt_id}}'::uuid AS attempt_id, '{{$json.attempt_number}}'::integer AS attempt_number, j.clinic_id, j.patient_id, j.appointment_id, j.conversation_id, j.channel_id, j.template_id, j.notification_type, COALESCE(a.scheduled_at, os.start_time) AS appointment_scheduled_at, c.name AS clinic_name, d.name AS doctor_name, s.name AS service_name, COALESCE(p.name, trim(COALESCE(p.first_name,'') || ' ' || COALESCE(p.last_name,'')), 'عميل MERUNA') AS patient_name, COALESCE(NULLIF(p.contact_phone,''), NULLIF(p.booking_phone,''), NULLIF(p.phone,'')) AS patient_phone, conv.channel_conversation_id, rdc.channel_type, rdc.provider, rdc.tenant_identifier, t.body_template, t.required_variables, t.optional_variables, CASE WHEN j.notification_type = 'waitlist_offer_created' THEN ao.expires_at ELSE NULL END AS offer_expires_at, ch.config->>'thikaa_instance_id' AS thikaa_instance_id FROM public.notification_jobs j JOIN public.patients p ON p.id = j.patient_id AND p.clinic_id = j.clinic_id JOIN public.clinics c ON c.id = j.clinic_id LEFT JOIN public.appointments a ON a.id = j.appointment_id AND a.clinic_id = j.clinic_id LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT o.expires_at, o.slot_id, o.patient_id FROM public.appointment_waitlist_offers o WHERE j.notification_type = 'waitlist_offer_created' AND o.id = CASE WHEN j.metadata->>'ai_offer_id' ~* '^[0-9a-f-]{36}$' THEN (j.metadata->>'ai_offer_id')::uuid END AND o.clinic_id = j.clinic_id AND o.patient_id = j.patient_id LIMIT 1) ao ON true LEFT JOIN public.appointment_slots os ON os.id = ao.slot_id AND os.clinic_id = j.clinic_id LEFT JOIN public.doctors d ON d.id = COALESCE(a.doctor_id, os.doctor_id) AND d.clinic_id = j.clinic_id LEFT JOIN public.services s ON s.id = COALESCE(a.service_id, os.service_id) AND s.clinic_id = j.clinic_id LEFT JOIN public.conversations conv ON conv.id = j.conversation_id AND conv.clinic_id = j.clinic_id JOIN public.notification_dispatch_ready_channels rdc ON rdc.channel_id = j.channel_id JOIN public.channels ch ON ch.id = j.channel_id AND ch.clinic_id = j.clinic_id JOIN public.notification_templates t ON t.id = j.template_id AND t.clinic_id = j.clinic_id WHERE j.id = '{{$json.job_id}}'::uuid LIMIT 1;
